effective_from, an old row's superseded_by names the row that replaced it).

account.purpose (migration 0025, phase 6 D156): `rental` is the account the property's
rent and costs run on; every other account of the household is `private`.

AcquisitionCostKind.description: Anschaffungsnebenkosten. Itemized so the AfA basis is traceable (principle 2).

AfaLine.title: AfaLine
AfaLine.description:
wk.afa for one tax year. amount, basis and rate are None without a selected split.

method (D79): `statutory` is the rate by completion year (rate set; the useful-life fields,
book_value_start and remaining_months None); `useful_life` is the shorter actual useful
life of a Gutachten, the book value at the start of the year spread over the months of that
life remaining at its start (rate None).

Allocation.description: Read shape of one allocation row (migration 0007).

AllocationCategory.title: AllocationCategory
AllocationCategory.description: §8.2. Default tax treatment in the comment (rules/categories.py is the source).

AllocationDraft.title: AllocationDraft
AllocationDraft.description:
What a matcher, a rule, the model or the user proposes for part of a transaction.
amount is signed like the transaction (a debit's parts are negative).

AllocationFact.title: AllocationFact
AllocationFact.description:
A confirmed allocation as the draft sees it. Amount signed (income +, costs −); a 0.00
row may be present and is ignored by every rule (D70). invoice_net is this allocation's
share of the linked invoice extraction's amount_net (a magnitude), for the 15 % tracker
(D56): the whole net for a payment of the whole bill, net × part ÷ gross for one part of a
bill split by its lines (phase 2 D135).

AllocationMethod.title: AllocationMethod
AllocationMethod.description: allocation.method (migration 0007): who proposed the allocation set.

AllocationSet.title: AllocationSet
AllocationSet.description:
One transaction's proposal. Σ amount must equal the transaction amount: checked by
rules.allocations.check_sum, which knows the transaction (allocation_sum.yaml).

AllocationStatus.title: AllocationStatus
AllocationStatus.description:
allocation.status (migration 0007, D23). The only column a trigger lets change, and
only forward: proposed -> confirmed, proposed -> superseded, confirmed -> superseded.

AmountItem.title: AmountItem
AmountItem.description: One typed row of a sum block (dues, training, other).

AnlageNDraft.title: AnlageNDraft
AnlageNDraft.description:
One owner's Anlage N for one year (§5.6). status: certified (from certificates),
estimate (payslip projection or expected pay), none (no pay source).

AnlageNYears.title: AnlageNYears
AnlageNYears.description: GET /tax/anlage-n/years: the tax years with an Anlage N rule set file of their own.

AppUser.title: AppUser
AppUser.description: A person who can sign in. Auth credentials (passkey / TOTP) land with the API PR.

AppliedEntity.title: AppliedEntity
AppliedEntity.description:
One record of an applied proposal and the entity it created or patched (for a link,
the entity the document was linked to). entity_id is null for a skipped record.

AssessedTax.title: AssessedTax
AssessedTax.description:
§5.10: the tax as assessed. est = est_with + kindergeld when the allowances win, else
est_without; Soli and church tax on est_with minus the §35a credit (§51a Abs. 2 S. 1).

Assumption.title: Assumption
Assumption.description: A stated assumption of the projection, as data; the frontend holds the German text.

BalanceSource.title: BalanceSource
BalanceSource.description: statement_import.balance_source: where the declared balances came from (D21).

BankConnection.title: BankConnection
BankConnection.description:
GET /accounts/{id}/bank-connection: the login masked, the client state only as a flag
(client_data and its MAC never leave the database).

BankConnectionCreate.title: BankConnectionCreate
BankConnectionCreate.description:
POST /accounts/{id}/bank-connection. The PIN is never part of it (D119): it is the
container secret HAUSBUCH_FINTS_PIN.

BankConnectionPatch.title: BankConnectionPatch
BankConnectionPatch.description:
PATCH /accounts/{id}/bank-connection. A changed URL or login keeps the stored client
state only while its MAC verifies (step 1); null is not accepted for any field.

BankCredentialSlots.title: BankCredentialSlots
BankCredentialSlots.description:
GET /bank-credential-slots (phase 6 D163): the slots whose container secret is set,
names only, so the Bankabruf card can say which variable is still missing.

BankStatement.title: BankStatement
BankStatement.description:
GET /accounts/{id}/bank-statements: one PDF statement the bank delivered (bank_statement,
D154 (5)), with the document it is stored as and the run that fetched it. Never the PDF.

BankSync.title: BankSync
BankSync.description:
One run (bank_sync, §4.2). lines_* are null until the preview ran; import_id is set
once the run wrote its import (status importing or done), and a run that failed after
that keeps it (status failed); never for nothing_new (D127).

BasisAddition.title: BasisAddition
BasisAddition.description:
Herstellungskosten added to the AfA basis in the year paid, accruing from 1 January of
that year (§5.2). The amount is gross: input VAT a VAT-exempt landlord cannot deduct is part
of the Herstellungskosten (§9b Abs. 1 EStG); only the 15 % test itself is net (§5.3).
Since D137 it may be a private_cost row (tax_input_id) moved by the 15 % crossing.

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

sender.description: name of the authority, without the address

amount_total.description: the amount assessed; when the document holds several Bescheide (e.g. one per buyer of a joint purchase), the sum of their assessed amounts, the one value you add up yourself

tax_year.description: the year it concerns, if stated

cost_lines.description: every cost line of the bill, each written `text | amount | code`: the line's text and its amount as printed, then the code of the kind of cost it is, the only part you choose yourself, one of acquisition_cost, loan_fees, repairs, renovation, insurance, grundsteuer, property_management, hausgeld_umlagefaehig, hausgeld_verwaltung, electricity, professional_fees, bank_fees, other_expense, vat (acquisition_cost for the purchase and its land register entry, loan_fees for a Grundschuld or loan, vat for the Umsatzsteuer line); never a subtotal (Netto, Zwischensumme) or the total; when the document holds several Bescheide (e.g. one per buyer of a joint purchase), each Bescheid's assessed amount is its own line, its text naming that Bescheid only as Bescheid 1, Bescheid 2 and so on, or by its share or base (e.g. 3,5 % von 150.000), never by a person's name, an identification number or a Steuernummer

BescheidExtraction.title: BescheidExtraction
BescheidExtraction.description: A Bescheid other than Grundsteuer, e.g. the Grunderwerbsteuerbescheid.

CarriedField.title: CarriedField
CarriedField.description:
A field of another record of the same proposal (D132): its record key and field name,
dotted as the apply body names it ("tax_input:interest_certified", "value.amount").

CategoryChange.title: CategoryChange
CategoryChange.description: A category's rate when the Pauschale was set and today, for the whole flat.

ChecklistBankLine.title: ChecklistBankLine
ChecklistBankLine.description:
A confirmed allocation as a checklist item cites it (D142): no counterparty, no purpose
text (D5); the frontend labels it by date and amount and opens its bank line.

ChecklistDepositCandidate.title: ChecklistDepositCandidate
ChecklistDepositCandidate.description:
A tenancy an unlinked deposit line could be split to (D142): it has a deposit (cash),
its proof is missing, it did not end before the line's booking date and no deposit line is
linked to it yet. unit_id: the allocation row's unit (it must be the tenancy's).

ChecklistDepositOffer.title: ChecklistDepositOffer
ChecklistDepositOffer.description:
An unlinked `deposit_in` line of the property, offered on a missing deposit_record item
whose tenancy is among `candidates` (D142). candidates: every such tenancy of the year's
items, by tenancy start then id; the frontend proposes a split only from these.

ChecklistDocumentRef.title: ChecklistDocumentRef
ChecklistDocumentRef.description:
A satisfying document, without its title or filename (either can name a tenant, D5):
the frontend labels it by type and date and links to the document.

ChecklistItem.title: ChecklistItem
ChecklistItem.description:
build_checklist's output. documents: the satisfying documents (present) or the ones
lacking a tax year (incomplete), oldest first; empty otherwise (also for a deposit proven
by its bank lines only, D142, which lists them in bank_lines).

ChecklistScope.title: ChecklistScope
ChecklistScope.description: The item's subject and its non-personal context (no tenant names, D5).

ChecklistScopeType.title: ChecklistScopeType
ChecklistScopeType.description: What one item is about: property, cost row, loan, tenancy, allocation or unit.

ChildFact.title: ChildFact
ChildFact.description:
A child of the household (phase 4b D109; return_input kind child, household scope). No
name and no other identifier: the birth date decides the months, and it never enters an
event payload (only months_in_year does). kindergeld_from: the first month Kindergeld is
paid, when it differs from the birth month.

ChildMonthsDetail.title: ChildMonthsDetail
ChildMonthsDetail.description: One child's months in the year (D109), with the birth month only: never the day.

CommuteComponent.title: CommuteComponent
CommuteComponent.description:
§5.2: the routes' Pauschale (the non-car part capped), the tickets when higher, minus
the employer's tax-free and flat-taxed commute benefits, floored at 0.

CommuteFact.title: CommuteFact
CommuteFact.description:
One route for one period (§5.2). km_car + km_collective + km_other = km; a decimal
distance typed as a string ("25.9") is floored to full km.

CommuteRateTier.title: CommuteRateTier
CommuteRateTier.description: §9 Abs. 1 S. 3 Nr. 4 EStG: the rate per full kilometre and day from from_km on.

CommuteRouteDetail.title: CommuteRouteDetail
CommuteRouteDetail.description:
One route as typed, with its part of the Pauschale (§5.2): the car km and the other km
(Sammelbeförderung, Bus, Bahn, Rad) each × days × rate, to the cent.

ConfirmAllocationsBody.title: ConfirmAllocationsBody
ConfirmAllocationsBody.description:
PUT /transactions/{id}/allocations: the user's allocation set and the "Künftig immer
so zuordnen" checkbox.

Only the set's allocations are read: the rows are written with method `user` and
confidence 1, whatever method, confidence, rule_id or ai_call_id the body carries. A set
equal to the current proposed rows confirms those rows as they are (the proposer's method
stays); one equal to the current confirmed rows changes nothing.

learn_rule: null = the server default (TransactionAllocations.learn_rule_default for this
set); true for a set no rule can be learned from is refused with rule.not_learnable.
The patterns (case-insensitive regular expressions, refused with rule.invalid_pattern
when they do not compile) narrow the rule, and let a line without an IBAN, or a
counterparty a matcher owns (D38), have one.
same_amount_only (D49): the answer to "Gehören die auch zu …?" when other amounts from
the same IBAN are waiting: true = the rule books only payments of this line's amount (the
latest confirmed one of its category, read from the ledger); ignored without learn_rule
and for a rule whose split method checks the amount itself.

CostLevel.title: CostLevel
CostLevel.description:
The flat's costs per month in force on `as_of`: one rate per FLAT_RATE_CATEGORIES, in that
order; `betrkv` is the sum of the three BetrKV rates (electricity left out).

CostRate.title: CostRate
CostRate.description:
One category's monthly rate in force on a date (D155 (2)), with what it came from
(principle 2): the allocations of the payment or the 12 months, or the schedule's tax
input. `from_later`: nothing was known on or before the date, so the first payment (or the
first schedule, or the first 12 months of lines) after it stands for it, as the handover
month's payment does for a lease that began before the landlord paid anything.

CountedCost.title: CountedCost
CountedCost.description:
A cost the 15 % test counts: an allocation (booking_date set), or since D137 a
private_cost row (tax_input_id, no booking_date: the row has a tax year, not a bank line).

Currency.title: Currency
Currency.description:
transaction.currency. v1 is EUR only (one value, kept as a CHECK'd set like
InvitePurpose).

DateCorrection.title: DateCorrection
DateCorrection.description: Corrects a milestone date: purchase date (Übergang) or move-in.

DatedFlow.title: DatedFlow
DatedFlow.description:
One flow of the IRR (D89): −E₀ on the purchase date, each year's net cash on 31 Dec,
the net sale proceeds on the sale date.

DeclareBalanceBody.title: DeclareBalanceBody
DeclareBalanceBody.description: POST /imports/{id}/balances: the closing balance Luis reads in online banking.

DepositReceipt.title: DepositReceipt
DepositReceipt.description:
GET /tenancies/{id}/deposits: one Kaution payment received (a tenancy.deposit_received
event; the latest of its chain, should one ever be corrected).

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is
a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

report_date.description: the date the positions are stated for (Stichtag)

positions.description: every position the report lists, one item per security, each written `ISIN | name | units | price | value | currency`, as printed; never a subtotal or the total row

trades.description: every trade of the report's Wertpapierumsätze list, one item per trade, each written `ISIN | trade date | units | amount | reference`, as printed; unbekannt for a part the row does not state

DepotReportExtraction.title: DepotReportExtraction
DepotReportExtraction.description:
Quartalsbericht (depot_report, D165 (3)): the positions on a date and the period's
trades, from which code proposes holding_statement rows.

DisbursementCorrection.title: DisbursementCorrection
DisbursementCorrection.description:
POST /loans/{id}/corrections/disbursement: the payout date and/or the principal; an
absent (or null) field keeps the recorded value.

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

units.description: the units (Stück, Anteile) held on the record date

gross_per_unit.description: the distribution per unit, before taxes

withholding_tax.description: foreign withholding tax (Quellensteuer) deducted, if any

german_taxes.description: German taxes deducted: Kapitalertragsteuer, Solidaritätszuschlag and Kirchensteuer, summed

net_amount.description: the amount credited to the cash account

currency.description: the currency of the amounts, as a three-letter code

Document.title: Document
Document.description: One per file per workspace: re-uploading the same bytes returns this row.

DocumentDetail.title: DocumentDetail
DocumentDetail.description: GET /documents/{id}: one read transaction over the document and its layers.

DocumentExtraction.title: DocumentExtraction
DocumentExtraction.description:
Append-only. A new version is a new row; the highest version is current.

kind (phase 2, migration 0005) says which field set `fields` holds: `manual` is
ManualDocumentFields, every other kind its per-type model in schemas/extraction.py. The
kind is a column, not a key inside the fields, so the union is resolved from it here
rather than by a Pydantic discriminator. ai_call_id is the call an `ai` version came from
(D18); a `manual` version on top of it (Luis edited extracted fields) has none.

DocumentLink.title: DocumentLink
DocumentLink.description: Links a document to exactly one entity (the thing it proves).

DocumentSubtype.title: DocumentSubtype
DocumentSubtype.description: Finer typing where retention or the AfA basis depends on it.

DocumentType.title: DocumentType
DocumentType.description: The classifier's output set (AI layer). Phase 1 sets it by hand.

DocumentTyping.title: DocumentTyping
DocumentTyping.description: What a person (phase 1) or the classifier (phase 2) says the document is.

DocumentTypingBody.title: DocumentTypingBody
DocumentTypingBody.description:
PUT /documents/{id}/typing. `shown_version` is the extraction version the hand fields
were shown from (0: none yet), required with `fields`; a save from a version that is no
longer current is refused (document.extraction_stale, phase 2 D37).

DocumentUploadResult.title: DocumentUploadResult
DocumentUploadResult.description:
POST /documents with ai = true (§6.1): the document plus the queued proposal to
poll. proposal_id is null when the upload did not ask for a proposal.

DraftWarning.title: DraftWarning
DraftWarning.description:
A warning as data; the frontend holds the German text. params are strings (amounts as
decimal strings, dates ISO) so the draft's JSON is the same before and after a round trip.
severity defaults from WARNING_SEVERITY and must agree with it.

EntityType.title: EntityType
EntityType.description: Entities that carry events. Also the prefix of every event type.

EquipmentFact.title: EquipmentFact
EquipmentFact.description: One work item or subscription (D108). bought_on may lie before the tax year.

EquipmentItemDetail.title: EquipmentItemDetail
EquipmentItemDetail.description:
§5.5: one item's amount in the year. method `full`: the base in the purchase year only
(a subscription, a low-value item, a class written off at once); `depreciated`: the base
over `life_months` from the purchase month, `months_in_year` of them in this year.

ErrorKind.title: ErrorKind
ErrorKind.description: ErrorResponse.error: the stable string the frontend switches on.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: Every non-2xx body. Only the fields that apply to `error` are set (see ErrorKind).

EstimateLineSources.title: EstimateLineSources
EstimateLineSources.description:
What each line of the whole-return estimate came from, so the Gesamt card opens the
sources line by line (ReturnEstimate.sources stays their union). The Anlage N and V lines
carry theirs on OwnerIncome and PropertyIncome.

ExtractedValue.title: ExtractedValue
ExtractedValue.description:
One field of a per-type extraction, or of a proposal record.

checks say what code verified: `cited` (the API attached a citation, so `source` is set),
`value_in_quote` (the value is recoverable from the cited text), `validates` (the value
passes the target field's Pydantic type), `derived` (code computed it from the fields in
`derived_from`, e.g. building_share). The confidence is a function of the checks, computed
by rules.extraction_parse (fixture extraction_parse.yaml); this model only enforces that
the checks are consistent with the other fields.

ExtractionKind.title: ExtractionKind
ExtractionKind.description:
document_extraction.kind and proposal.kind (migration 0005): which field set an
extraction holds. `manual` is phase 1's ManualDocumentFields; the others are the per-type
models in schemas/extraction.py.

FieldDecision.title: FieldDecision
FieldDecision.description:
What the user did with one proposed value. Recorded per field on apply, without the
value (proposal.applied event, eval record).

FieldError.title: FieldError
FieldError.description: One validation error, whitelisted to these three keys: never input, ctx or url (§3.6).

FieldOption.title: FieldOption
FieldOption.description:
A value the review offers for one field with one click (D139): the field's value as
the apply body sends it and its label, e.g. "61.40" and "WE 3 · 2. OG links · 61,40 m²"
for a Wohnflächenberechnung's dwelling the code could not pick by itself.

FilingCheck.title: FilingCheck
FilingCheck.description:
§46 Abs. 2 EStG. deadline: 31 July of the following year (§149 Abs. 2 S. 1 AO), moved
to the next working day when that is a Saturday, Sunday or a nationwide public holiday
(§108 Abs. 3 AO); computed by rule, never typed. Regional holidays are not considered.

FlatRateCheck.title: FlatRateCheck
FlatRateCheck.description:
GET /properties/{id}/flat-rate-check (D155): information, not advice; §560 BGB decides.

`levels` are the cost levels on every tenancy's set_on and on `as_of` (today), distinct and
ascending; `tenancies` the flat_rate tenancies in force on `as_of`; both empty without one.
`settlements` are the hints of the 12 months up to `as_of`.

FlatRateLetterFigures.title: FlatRateLetterFigures
FlatRateLetterFigures.description:
GET /tenancies/{id}/flat-rate-letter (D155 (7)): the figures of the letter for one
tenancy's rise or fall, from the FlatRateCheck of `as_of` (today); the dialog shows them
before the PDF is made and the PDF prints exactly these.

`reasons`: the BetrKV categories with a cost then or now, in FLAT_RATE_BETRKV order.
`new_pauschale` = pauschale + rise, to the cent, never below 0.00; `new_total` = the cold
rent in force on the later of `as_of` and `starts_on`, + new_pauschale. `starts_on`: for a
raise the first day of the month after next from `sent_on` (§560 Abs. 2 BGB), for a lower
the date the cost fell (§560 Abs. 3 BGB).

FlatRateLetterRequest.title: FlatRateLetterRequest
FlatRateLetterRequest.description:
POST /tenancies/{id}/flat-rate-letter (D155 (7)): what the dialog asks. The sender's
name and address lines are printed and never stored (the browser may remember them).

FormStatus.title: FormStatus
FormStatus.description: Whether a form mapping is the year's published form or a copy of an earlier one (§4.3).

Fraction.title: Fraction
Fraction.description: An exact share: ownership (1/2) or Miteigentumsanteil (85/1000).

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

street.description: street of the property the document concerns

dwellings.description: every dwelling the document lists, one item per Wohnung, each written `label | Wohnfläche | MEA | Lage`: the dwelling's label as printed (e.g. WE 3, Wohnung Nr. 3), its Wohnfläche in m² as printed, its Miteigentumsanteil as printed (e.g. 85/1000) and its location in the building (e.g. 2. OG links), unbekannt for a part the row does not state; one item for a document about one flat; never a single room, a sum or a total row

remaining_useful_life.description: the Restnutzungsdauer or tatsächliche Nutzungsdauer of the building the Gutachten concludes, in years as written (e.g. 21 Jahre); never the Gesamtnutzungsdauer, the building's age or a life the Gutachten only quotes from a table

valuation_date.description: the Wertermittlungsstichtag or Bewertungsstichtag the remaining life is stated for; never the date the Gutachten was written or signed

lender.description: the bank that gave the loan

contract_number.description: Darlehensnummer / Vertragsnummer; when none is printed, the loan's Kontonummer. The number only, without its label

GeneralExtraction.title: GeneralExtraction
GeneralExtraction.description:
The general reading (D130): title and date for every document without a reader of its
own, plus the one field set its subtype's group needs to find its link (D131): the
property's address for the property, WEG, running-costs and tenancy groups, the lender and
contract number for the loan group. A request asks only those (asked_fields); an
owner's home address is never asked. A Wohnflächenberechnung (building_records) is also
asked its list of dwellings (D139), a Gutachten (appraisal) its remaining useful life and
Stichtag (D147).

GrundsteuerSchedule.title: GrundsteuerSchedule
GrundsteuerSchedule.description:
The Grundsteuerbescheid's schedule (phase 5 D126; §28 GrStG). tax_year on the row is the
first year it applies to, document_id the Bescheid; a later year repeats this row's dates
(same day and month) until a newer row exists. Every amount is a confirmed figure from the
Bescheid, never a model's (D13-D15).

payment_mode None = inferred (D126): `remind` until an earlier instalment was cleared by a
direct-debit line, then `sepa_mandate`. rhythm is informational (the Bescheid's wording);
the dates are what reminders use.

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

tax_year.description: first year the Bescheid applies to

HandFields.title: HandFields
HandFields.description:
The document's "Felder (von Hand)" as the typing form shows them (phase 2 D37).

For a `manual` extraction (or none) the values are its fields and all six are available.
For an AI kind, `values` holds what the reading stored for the fields that kind has a place
for (rules.hand_fields.HAND_FIELD_MAP), and `available` names exactly those; a reading the
hand types cannot hold (a low-confidence raw text in a money field) shows as null.

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is
a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

HausgeldabrechnungExtraction.title: HausgeldabrechnungExtraction
HausgeldabrechnungExtraction.description: Hausgeldabrechnung: the year's settlement (read by phase 3's Hausgeld rule).

HouseholdCashflow.title: HouseholdCashflow
HouseholdCashflow.description: GET /household/cashflow?month= (the Haushalt screen): confirmed allocations only.

HouseholdGroup.title: HouseholdGroup
HouseholdGroup.description:
The group a household code is shown under (mockup 10's spending groups and the
others; rules/household/taxonomy.py).

HouseholdTaxContext.title: HouseholdTaxContext
HouseholdTaxContext.description:
What the assessed tax needs beyond the zvE (phase 4b D98, D109, D112), built by
household_context: the children, the Lohnersatzleistungen after the §32b Abs. 2 reduction,
church tax paid, the donations within the cap, childcare within the cap, and the §35a
credit. Without it, the assessed tax is the plain tariff (total_tax).

ImportStatus.title: ImportStatus
ImportStatus.description:
statement_import.status. `imported` with no declared closing balance is what the
inbox shows as "pending balance" (reconcile's pending_balance).

InboundDecision.title: InboundDecision
InboundDecision.description:
inbound_mail.decision (migration 0019). accepted and rejected are final at once; a
message is final after three failed rows (MAX_ATTEMPTS).

InboundMail.title: InboundMail
InboundMail.description:
GET /inbound-mail: one attempt's row with the documents and imports it produced (the
table names its timestamp recorded_at, so not Record, as TaxInput).

InboxAddress.title: InboxAddress
InboxAddress.description:
GET /inbound-mail/address (§11, Einstellungen › Posteingang-Adresse): the token
address to forward to and the label the app reads, both null while email-in is not set
up (the four HAUSBUCH_INBOX_* values, §5.2). The IMAP login and the app password never
leave the server.

InboxItem.title: InboxItem
InboxItem.description:
One thing to act on, with a one-line reasoning and one question. Exactly the ids its
action endpoint needs are set.

IncomeInput.title: IncomeInput
IncomeInput.description: API read model (the table names its timestamp recorded_at, so not Record).

IncomeInputCreate.title: IncomeInputCreate
IncomeInputCreate.description:
One income input row as written. A correction is a new row with supersedes_id (a
current row of the same kind, year and owner); withdrawn = true ends a row without
replacing it (its value repeats the withdrawn row's). Rows are never changed.

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

tax_year.description: the year assessed (Bescheid für 20xx über Einkommensteuer ...)

taxable_income.description: zu versteuerndes Einkommen (not Summe der Einkünfte, Gesamtbetrag der Einkünfte or Einkommen)

assessment_type.description: the kind of assessment, e.g. Zusammenveranlagung or Einzelveranlagung

addressee.description: the names of the persons the Bescheid is for, names only

IncomeTaxAssessmentExtraction.title: IncomeTaxAssessmentExtraction
IncomeTaxAssessmentExtraction.description:
Einkommensteuerbescheid (bescheid / einkommensteuerbescheid; phase-4b.md D129, §8.4):
the assessed zvE of one year, proposed as the household's bescheid_zve. Only these fields:
no identifier, no address, no other figure of the assessment is ever read.

InitialRent.title: InitialRent
InitialRent.description: The first rent row, recorded with the tenancy (reason 'initial').

Invite.title: Invite
Invite.description:
A pending enrollment invite. enrollment_url is set only in the POST /auth/invites
response, the one time the raw token exists; GET /auth/invites never has it.

InviteCreate.title: InviteCreate
InviteCreate.description: POST /auth/invites: a household member to invite (creates their app_user row).

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

sender.description: name of who issued it, without the address: decides the cost kind

subject.description: what it is for, as written (Betreff / Gegenstand)

cost_lines.description: every cost line of the bill, each written `text | amount | code`: the line's text and its amount as printed, then the code of the kind of cost it is, the only part you choose yourself, one of acquisition_cost, loan_fees, repairs, renovation, insurance, grundsteuer, property_management, hausgeld_umlagefaehig, hausgeld_verwaltung, electricity, professional_fees, bank_fees, other_expense, vat (acquisition_cost for the purchase and its land register entry, loan_fees for a Grundschuld or loan, vat for the Umsatzsteuer line); never a subtotal (Netto, Zwischensumme) or the total

InvoiceExtraction.title: InvoiceExtraction
InvoiceExtraction.description: Invoices: Nebenkosten (notary, Grundbuchamt, broker) now, repairs and others later.

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

unit_label.description: the let unit's label: for a single room let on its own the room (e.g. Zimmer 3), not the flat's floor or number; else the flat's label (e.g. WE 3)

signed_on.description: Vertragsdatum: when it was signed, often only as 'Ort, den <Datum>' by the signatures

operating_costs_prepayment.description: the monthly Nebenkosten besides the Kaltmiete: the Betriebskostenvorauszahlung, or a Nebenkostenpauschale (also one that includes Heizung, Warmwasser or Strom)

heating_costs_prepayment.description: Heizkostenvorauszahlung, only when the lease states it as its own amount

operating_costs_clause.description: the sentence(s) on how the Neben- or Betriebskosten are paid, as printed: a Vorauszahlung that is abgerechnet each year, a Pauschale with no Abrechnung (also 'eine gesonderte Abrechnung erfolgt nicht'), or one Inklusiv- or Warmmiete that includes them

rent_due_clause.description: when the monthly rent is due, as printed (e.g. 'spätestens am dritten Werktag eines jeden Monats', 'im Voraus zum 1. eines Monats')

LeaseExtraction.title: LeaseExtraction
LeaseExtraction.description: Mietvertrag (contract / lease). Step 2, gated by ai_tenant_documents (D16).

LetterReason.title: LetterReason
LetterReason.description:
One Betriebskosten category in the letter's reason (§560 Abs. 1 S. 2 BGB: named and
explained): the flat's monthly cost when the Pauschale was set and now, each with the
allocations or tax input it came from (the service looks up their documents). Electricity
is never a reason (D155 (3)).

Levers.title: Levers
Levers.description: What the user sets for a projection (D87). Defaults are the spec's (Q4, Luis).

LinkTarget.title: LinkTarget
LinkTarget.description: What a document can be linked to (document_link has one FK column per target).

LinkTargetRef.title: LinkTargetRef
LinkTargetRef.description: One entity a document is linked to (a document_link row without its own id).

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

contract_number.description: Darlehensnummer / Vertragsnummer; when none is printed, the loan's Kontonummer. The number only, without its label

follow_up_rate.description: Sollzins p.a. after the Sollzinsbindung ends, if stated: an agreed Anschlusszins, or the variable Sollzins the loan continues at (e.g. 'Der veränderliche Sollzinssatz beträgt derzeit ...'); never the Mindestzins, never the effektiver Jahreszins

interest_only_clause.description: the sentence saying that until Tilgungsbeginn, or until the first full Rate, only interest (Sollzinsen) is paid, as written, if the contract has one

signed_on.description: Vertragsdatum: when it was signed, often only as 'Ort, den <Datum>' by the signatures; when the parties signed on different dates, the latest of them

LoanCreateRequest.title: LoanCreateRequest
LoanCreateRequest.description: POST /loans: LoanCreate plus the contract date (create_loan's signed_on).

LoanTerms.title: LoanTerms
LoanTerms.description: Everything the schedule is computed from. Input to rules.loan_schedule.

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

manager.description: the Verwalter's name only, without the address

house_number.description: house number of the managed property

postal_code.description: five-digit PLZ of the managed property

monthly_fee.description: the Verwaltervergütung per month as written, e.g. 30,00 € zzgl. MwSt. je Einheit

fee_net.description: the Verwaltervergütung per month as a number, as the contract states it, before any MwSt. the contract adds

amount_total.description: Betrag: the monthly fee with MwSt.

ManagementContractExtraction.title: ManagementContractExtraction
ManagementContractExtraction.description:
Verwaltervertrag (contract / management_contract, D130): a Mietverwaltungsvertrag with
the household's letting manager, or the WEG's Verwaltervertrag. Proposes typing and
link:property; the fee is booked from the bank lines that pay it, never from here.

ManualDocumentFields.title: ManualDocumentFields
ManualDocumentFields.description: The fields a person types in phase 1. Per-type schemas replace this in phase 2.

MarketRent.title: MarketRent
MarketRent.description: The Mietspiegel's net cold rent per m² (D61); the running costs come from the ledger.

Me.title: Me
Me.description: GET /auth/me, and the response of a successful sign-in or enrollment.

Member.title: Member
Member.description:
GET /auth/members: one household member (an app_user of the workspace). has_passkey
is false while an invited member has not enrolled yet. Never a passkey or a session.

MissingItem.title: MissingItem
MissingItem.description:
Something the estimate still waits for: an open question slot, a document, or a
benefit letter answered "yes, pending".

MovableAfaLine.title: MovableAfaLine
MovableAfaLine.description:
wk.afa_movable for one asset and tax year (D80): linear over useful_life_years from the
AfA start month of from_year (§7 Abs. 1 EStG), pro rata by the months owned; the last year
takes the rest, then 0.00.

basis = amount × (price + Σ cost rows) ÷ price when in_purchase_price (its share of the
Nebenkosten goes with it), else amount. book_value_start is the basis less the AfA of
earlier years; remaining_months the months of the life left at the start of the year.

MovableAsset.title: MovableAsset
MovableAsset.description:
A movable asset with its own AfA (D80; BFH IX R 14/15: a fitted kitchen is not part of
the building). tax_year on the row is its first year (the purchase year when it came with
the flat); document_id is optional (the estimate's evidence, e.g. a planner printout).

amount is its share of the purchase price, gross (or its own price when bought separately).
in_purchase_price: bought with the flat, so its basis (amount plus its share of the
Nebenkosten) leaves the building's AfA basis, never the land's.

MovedPayment.title: MovedPayment
MovedPayment.description: A payment booked in the draft's year that §5.1 counts in another year (or vice versa).

OpenTransfer.title: OpenTransfer
OpenTransfer.description: One leg waiting for its counterpart, with the legs it may be linked to.

OpenTransferCode.title: OpenTransferCode
OpenTransferCode.description:
GET /transfers/open: why a leg waits for a person (D162). proposed: a counterpart
fits but no link was written (a leg without an own IBAN, or one booked before the
other).

OperatingCostsTerms.title: OperatingCostsTerms
OperatingCostsTerms.description: How a lease agrees the running costs (tenancy.operating_costs_terms, 0013; phase 3 D72).

OwnerGain.title: OwnerGain
OwnerGain.description:
One spouse's share of a §23 gain, tested against the Freigrenze of the sale year's rule
set (`speculation_freigrenze`, D93; a cliff).

OwnerZve.title: OwnerZve
OwnerZve.description:
One owner's part of the estimate (D84). deductions = the default, the override, or (phase
4b D98) the Anlage N's applied Werbungskosten + Vorsorge + 36. gross_source says where the
gross came from: the expected_gross_pay row, or a certificate or the payslip projection.

Passkey.title: Passkey
Passkey.description: GET /auth/passkeys: one passkey of the signed-in user.

PasskeyVerifyRequest.title: PasskeyVerifyRequest
PasskeyVerifyRequest.description: POST /auth/passkeys/verify: a further passkey for the signed-in user.

PaymentIbanProposal.title: PaymentIbanProposal
PaymentIbanProposal.description:
The payment IBAN a card statement prints (D176 (4)), masked; POST
/accounts/{id}/payment-iban with its import_id confirms it.

PaymentProofBody.title: PaymentProofBody
PaymentProofBody.description:
Phase 3 D149: the bill an existing payment proof pays (the to-do's „Vorhandenen
Nachweis zuordnen“).

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

paid_on.description: the day the payment was made: Ausführungsdatum, Buchungstag or Wertstellung of the transfer

amount.description: the amount transferred, as stated; never a balance, a limit or a fee

payee.description: the payee (Empfänger, Zahlungsempfänger) only; never the payer, the account holder or any other person

purpose.description: the Verwendungszweck as stated, without any account details

PaymentProofExtraction.title: PaymentProofExtraction
PaymentProofExtraction.description:
Zahlungsnachweis (other / payment_proof; phase-3.md D143): the proof that a bill was
paid, uploaded from the bill's to-do. Only these fields, besides the title and date every
reading carries: no IBAN, no account number and no name but the payee is ever asked for,
and the quotes are scrubbed of identifiers (jobs.document_read).

Payslip.title: Payslip
Payslip.description:
One month's payslip of one employer (D105). months_remaining_paid defaults to
12 − month in the review; fewer when pay stops before December.

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

employee_name.description: the employee's name, to match the owner

period_month.description: the month paid, as its first day

PayslipExtraction.title: PayslipExtraction
PayslipExtraction.description:
Gehaltsabrechnung: one month, with the month column and the year-to-date column
(Jahreswerte / kumuliert). Net pay and the bank account are not read.

PossibleDuplicate.title: PossibleDuplicate
PossibleDuplicate.description:
transaction_id was stored first; other_transaction_id is the later-imported line,
the one `merged` excludes.

PriceSplitCreate.title: PriceSplitCreate
PriceSplitCreate.description: One candidate building/land split. Rows are append-only; the property selects one.

PriceSplitSource.title: PriceSplitSource
PriceSplitSource.description: Where the building/land split of the purchase price comes from.

PrivateCostValue.title: PrivateCostValue
PrivateCostValue.description:
A rental cost paid from a private account (phase 4b D111): trips to the flat, postage,
a landlords' association, software and the like; tax_year on the row is the year paid.
travel: trips × km_round_trip × the rule set's travel_rate_per_km (no amount typed);
every other class: amount × share. financing (phase 4b D134) is a Geldbeschaffungskosten
bill paid privately, such as the notary and land registry for the Grundschuld: it goes to
wk.financing_costs, every other class to wk.other. Phase 2 D135: a cost a bill's reading
proposes carries its `category` (PRIVATE_COST_CATEGORIES, with class other, or financing
for loan_fees); the draft then books it on that category's line of the rule set's
category_lines, as a confirmed allocation of the category would land. The label is free
text: it stays in the row and never enters the event payload (only amounts and codes do).

Phase 3 D137: a row whose category the 15 % test counts (LIMIT_15_CATEGORIES) may carry
performed_on (when the work was done, the date tested against the window, D76) and
amount_net (the bill's net for this part, before share; at most amount); a row without
them is counted conservatively. Other rows carry neither.

ProgressionInfo.title: ProgressionInfo
ProgressionInfo.description:
§32b (D102): the special rate is income_tax(zvE + L) ÷ (zvE + L), truncated to four
decimals of the percentage (six of the fraction, H 32b EStH 2025 Fall B: 6,8648 %), and
applied to the zvE with the tax floored to whole euros.

PropertyOwnership.title: PropertyOwnership
PropertyOwnership.description: Shares per property must sum to exactly 1 (service-layer rule, see fixtures).

PropertyPatch.title: PropertyPatch
PropertyPatch.description: Non-milestone fields only: the purchase dates and price change through corrections.

Proposal.title: Proposal
Proposal.description:
Read shape. kind is null until the document is classified (the row is created
`queued` at upload); records is empty until `ready`, and again after the D19 scrub.

ProposalApplyResult.title: ProposalApplyResult
ProposalApplyResult.description: POST /proposals/{id}/apply: the applied proposal and what each record became.

ProposalRecord.title: ProposalRecord
ProposalRecord.description:
One record the proposal would create or patch.

key: "property", "unit", "cost:notary", "loan", "tenant:1", "tenancy", "rent", "typing",
  "price_split", "ownership", "link:property", "correction:notarized_on", ...
fields: by the *Create / *Patch field name; a nested field is dotted ("address.city").
  Values the apply step supplies itself (the document as Beleg or evidence, the ids of
  records created in the same apply, a split's source) are not fields.
current: the existing record's values of the same fields, when target_id is set.

ProposalRerunBody.title: ProposalRerunBody
ProposalRerunBody.description:
POST /documents/{id}/proposals (optional body): read the document again. The
tenant-data flag is copied from the document's latest proposal; true adds it, false
never removes it (D16).

ProposalStatus.title: ProposalStatus
ProposalStatus.description: proposal.status (§3.1). applied and rejected are decisions; the rest are job states.

ProposalTargetMode.title: ProposalTargetMode
ProposalTargetMode.description: proposal.target_mode: whether the proposal creates new records or patches `targets`.

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

purchase_date.description: Übergang von Besitz, Nutzen und Lasten

land_value.description: price share allocated to the land, if stated

unit_label.description: WE Nr. as in the Teilungserklärung, e.g. WE 3

QuestionTarget.title: QuestionTarget
QuestionTarget.description:
What a "yes" leads to: rows of a return_input or tax_input kind, or a reminder printed on
the Gesamt card and the sheet. value_match selects the target rows by their value's coded
fields (e.g. {"item_class": "subscription"}, {"expense_class": "account_fee"}), so two
questions can share one kind (spec §7 addition, 10 Nov 2026).

QuestionnaireAnswerBody.title: QuestionnaireAnswerBody
QuestionnaireAnswerBody.description: POST /tax/questionnaire/answers: the answer and the rows it brings, written together.

QuestionnaireAnswerCreate.title: QuestionnaireAnswerCreate

QuestionnaireAnswerValue.title: QuestionnaireAnswerValue
QuestionnaireAnswerValue.description:
questionnaire_answer.answer (migration 0018, D110). not_applicable is recorded too, so
"answered no" differs from "not asked yet".

QuestionnaireSlot.title: QuestionnaireSlot
QuestionnaireSlot.description:
One slot of the viewed year: what last year leaves (QuestionPrefill) plus the slot's
current answer of this year, if any, so the screen can show it and correct it with a new
answer whose supersedes_id names it. The rows written with an answer are not linked to it;
the screen reads the slot's current rows from /return-inputs and the property's
/tax-inputs.

QuestionnaireView.title: QuestionnaireView
QuestionnaireView.description:
GET /tax/questionnaire: the year's questions and slots in file order (owners in name
order) and the progress. reused_from is set when the year has no file of its own. questions
are the file's (texts, answer type, choices, targets, carry-forward), each once; a slot
names its question by key, so the screen renders the question from the data, never from
its own copy (phase 4b §10, principle 5).

RateBasis.title: RateBasis
RateBasis.description: How a category's monthly rate was found (D155 (2)).

ReducedRentCheck.title: ReducedRentCheck
ReducedRentCheck.description:
§5.8 per Wohnung, monthly figures. market_warm = cold_rent_per_m2 × area + the year's
umlagefähige costs ÷ months owned. ratio_percent: agreed ÷ market_warm, one decimal; the
thresholds compare the exact ratio. cut_percent only below 50 %.

RelatedDocument.title: RelatedDocument
RelatedDocument.description:
GET /properties/{id}/documents and GET /units/{id}/documents: a document linked to the
target or to one of its children (units, tenancies, loans), with every such link.

ReminderKind.title: ReminderKind
ReminderKind.description: The catalogue's eleven kinds (§6.2); the value is the reminder key.

RentModel.title: RentModel
RentModel.description: How rent changes over time. Term (befristet / unbefristet) is a separate field.

RentRowCorrection.title: RentRowCorrection
RentRowCorrection.description:
POST /rent-schedule/{row_id}/corrections: the correction row's values; an absent field
keeps the wrong row's value (correct_rent_row).

RentScheduleCreate.title: RentScheduleCreate
RentScheduleCreate.description: A dated rent row. Never edited: a wrong row is superseded by a correction row.

ReplacementFact.title: ReplacementFact
ReplacementFact.description: A benefit paid by an authority (D102); the employer's Zuschuss is on the certificate.

RequirementCode.title: RequirementCode
RequirementCode.description: One kind of paperwork the return needs. German labels and hints live in the frontend.

RetentionHold.title: RetentionHold
RetentionHold.description: Why a retain_until date cannot be computed yet.

RetentionResult.title: RetentionResult
RetentionResult.description: Exactly one of retain_until / hold is set. retention_class is null only when untyped.

ReturnEstimate.title: ReturnEstimate
ReturnEstimate.description:
The whole-return estimate (§5.8, D101). result = assessed.total − withheld.total:
positive is a back-payment, negative a refund.

ReturnInputCreate.title: ReturnInputCreate
ReturnInputCreate.description:
One return input row as written. A correction is a new row with supersedes_id (a current
row of the same kind and year, and the same owner); withdrawn = true ends it. Rows are
never changed.

ReturnInputEvidence.title: ReturnInputEvidence
ReturnInputEvidence.description:
GET /return-inputs/{id}/evidence: the row's Beleg and, when the row was applied from a
pre-fill proposal, each value's page and quote (read-only, gap 3). `scrubbed` says the
proposal's values were removed 90 days after the decision (phase 2 D19), so only the Beleg
is left; `values` is then empty.

ReturnInputEvidenceValue.title: ReturnInputEvidenceValue
ReturnInputEvidenceValue.description:
One value of the pre-fill a row was applied from: where the document states it (page
and quote, when the model cited one) and what the user did with it on apply.

ReturnInputFact.title: ReturnInputFact
ReturnInputFact.description: A stored row as the rules see it (every row of the history, as TaxInputFact).

ReturnInputKind.title: ReturnInputKind
ReturnInputKind.description:
return_input.kind (migration 0018, phase 4b D97). Owner-scoped unless listed in
HOUSEHOLD_KINDS; read per year unless listed in SPANNING_KINDS (D110).

RuleMatcher.title: RuleMatcher
RuleMatcher.description:
What a rule matches on. No money field, by design: a rule never stores an amount.
Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions searched in the normalized text.

SaleResult.title: SaleResult
SaleResult.description:
D88, D89. gain is None when the sale is outside §23 (taxable False); a negative gain is
a loss that is not offset ("nicht verrechenbar", sale_tax 0.00).

ScheduleEntry.title: ScheduleEntry
ScheduleEntry.description:
interest = opening_balance * (nominal * (interest_days - follow_up_days)
+ follow_up * follow_up_days) / 360, rounded half-up (principle 2: traceable).

Session.title: Session
Session.description: The current session (Me.session). The cookie token is never part of any response.

SetOwnershipBody.title: SetOwnershipBody
SetOwnershipBody.description:
POST /accounts/{id}/ownership: the full current set. Σ = 1 and each owner once are
checked here; that each owner exists is the service's (ownership.owner_missing).

SettlementHint.title: SettlementHint
SettlementHint.description:
A line of a monthly category that is not an instalment (an electricity Jahresabrechnung,
a Hausgeldabrechnung's back-payment): not a rate, shown as a hint that the next instalment
may rise. `amount` is the cost (a refund is negative).

SplitMethod.title: SplitMethod
SplitMethod.description: matching_rule.split_method (D25): how a rule splits, never how much.

StateCode.title: StateCode
StateCode.description:
owner.tax_state (migration 0016, phase 4 D90): the Bundesland whose church tax rate
applies (rules/tax/tariffs/<year>.yaml, church_tax_rates).

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

StatementExtraction.title: StatementExtraction
StatementExtraction.description:
PDF Kontoauszug (§7.1): balances and lines. Every amount is a model reading, so the
reconciliation is the guard; `lines` holds one text per booking line, parsed into
StatementLines by bank.pdf.

SyncStatus.title: SyncStatus
SyncStatus.description: bank_sync.status (migration 0019, D118). done, nothing_new and failed are final.

SyncTrigger.title: SyncTrigger
SyncTrigger.description: bank_sync.trigger (migration 0019): a person's button or the daily schedule (D120).

TariffStamp.title: TariffStamp
TariffStamp.description: Which tariff a figure was computed with (shown with every projection).

TaxBreakdown.title: TaxBreakdown
TaxBreakdown.description:
T(zvE) of D82: Einkommensteuer (splitting, whole euros), Soli and church tax (cents).
Under a phase 4b household context (D98) it is the assessed tax: est after the
Günstigerprüfung, less the §35a credit (credit_35a, 0 on the plain tariff).

TaxEffect.title: TaxEffect
TaxEffect.description:
D82: effect = T(zvE_base + R) − T(zvE_base), or R × rate under an override (then the
two breakdowns are None). effective_rate = effect ÷ R in percent, one decimal half-up,
None for R = 0; slope (display only) is the tariff's slope at zvE_base including Soli and
church tax, shown when R = 0.

TaxExport.title: TaxExport
TaxExport.description:
A stored export (immutable). The draft it was built from is in the row's `draft`
column; the API returns it with the file's signed download URL, not inline.

TaxExportQueued.title: TaxExportQueued
TaxExportQueued.description:
POST /properties/{id}/anlage-v/exports or /owners/{id}/anlage-n/exports: the id to poll
GET /tax-exports/{id} with.

TaxExportState.title: TaxExportState
TaxExportState.description:
GET /tax-exports/{id}. `export` and `download_url` once ready; the URL is signed and
valid DOWNLOAD_TTL_S seconds, so a client fetches it right before downloading. An Anlage
N sheet names its owner, every other export its property (exactly one is set).

TaxInput.title: TaxInput
TaxInput.description: API read model (the table names its timestamp recorded_at, so not Record).

TaxInputCreate.title: TaxInputCreate
TaxInputCreate.description:
One tax input row as written. A correction is a new row with supersedes_id (the row it
replaces, a current row of the same kind and scope); withdrawn = true ends a decision
without replacing it (its value repeats the withdrawn row's). Rows are never changed.

TaxRateResult.title: TaxRateResult
TaxRateResult.description:
GET /api/tax-rate: the Steuern screen's "Steuerwirkung" line (§8, §9).

zve and effect are None together when no income input applies to the year or an earlier
one (`missing`, the flag income.missing: the screen shows "— · Einkommen eintragen").
owner_estimates lists each owner's gross pay, deductions (the D84 default or the typed
override) and estimate from the rows that apply, whatever the year's source, so the
Eigentümer page can show the computed default deductions under a Bescheid or an override
too.

TelecomComponent.title: TelecomComponent
TelecomComponent.description: §5.5: min(bills × share, cap_monthly × months) − employer reimbursement, floored at 0.

TenancyCreateRequest.title: TenancyCreateRequest
TenancyCreateRequest.description: POST /tenancies: TenancyCreate plus the first rent row (create_tenancy's initial_rent).

TenancyFlatRate.title: TenancyFlatRate
TenancyFlatRate.description:
One flat_rate tenancy in force on `as_of` (D155 (3), (4)).

`pauschale` is the rent row in force today's operating_costs_prepayment; `set_on` the date
it was set (the latest rent-schedule row in force that changed it, else the tenancy's
start). `changes` per FLAT_RATE_CATEGORIES compare the levels on `set_on` and today;
`flat_rise` is Σ of the BetrKV changes; `rise` = flat_rise × pauschale ÷ Σ Pauschalen,
half-up to the cent (0.00 when the Pauschalen sum to 0). `share_percent` is that share for
display only, one decimal; the rise is never computed from it. `earliest_start` (raise
only) is the first day of the month after next from `as_of` (§560 Abs. 2 BGB);
`fell_on` (lower only) the date the cost fell (§560 Abs. 3 BGB): of the BetrKV categories
whose rate fell, the earliest date from which its rate today applies (the first line of the
unbroken run of lines at today's rate; a schedule's 1 January).

`recorded_from` and `recorded_pauschale` (both or neither): the first rent row dated after
`as_of` that changes the Pauschale, a change already recorded (such as the pre-filled
„Mietänderung“). The verdict is then none (no to-do, no letter, no pre-fill), whatever the
rise; today's Pauschale stays in `pauschale` and the shares until the row takes effect.

TenancyPartiesBody.title: TenancyPartiesBody
TenancyPartiesBody.description: PUT /tenancies/{id}/parties: the whole list (exactly one primary; service rule).

TenancyPatch.title: TenancyPatch
TenancyPatch.description:
PATCH /tenancies/{id}: the non-milestone fields. Move-in, move-out, notice and contract
date change through their corrections, the parties through PUT .../parties.

Tenant.title: Tenant
Tenant.description: Read shape. After erasure every personal field is null and erased_at is set.

TimelineEntry.title: TimelineEntry
TimelineEntry.description: One milestone. For a correction chain A → B → C only one entry appears, showing C.

TrackedAmount.title: TrackedAmount
TrackedAmount.description: Booked, not deductible this year (Tilgung, Erhaltungsrücklage).

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

fees.description: the fees and costs charged on this trade, summed

net_amount.description: the amount debited or credited to the cash account (Ausmachender Betrag)

currency.description: the currency of the amounts, as a three-letter code

order_reference.description: the order or transaction reference (Auftragsnummer, Referenz)

TradeConfirmationExtraction.title: TradeConfirmationExtraction
TradeConfirmationExtraction.description: Wertpapierabrechnung (trade_confirmation, D165 (2)): one buy or sell of one security.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description:
Read shape. The counterparty IBAN is shown masked only. allocation_status and
allocation_categories are computed on read, never stored: the distinct categories of
the line's current allocation rows, the largest amount first.

TransactionAllocationStatus.title: TransactionAllocationStatus

TransactionAllocations.title: TransactionAllocations
TransactionAllocations.description:
GET / PUT /transactions/{id}/allocations: the line, its current allocation rows
(proposed or confirmed; none = not matched) and the rule checkbox.

can_learn_rule: whether a single-category answer for this line can become a rule
without a typed pattern (false without an IBAN, and for a counterparty a matcher owns,
D38). learn_rule_default: the checkbox's default for the current rows (off when a rule
cannot be learned from them, or a category never auto-confirms, review F6).
no_default_rule_categories: the categories that never auto-confirm (threshold None in
rules.review.THRESHOLDS), in taxonomy order, so the UI can default the checkbox for rows
the person types (on unless one of these is among them, §8.1).
waiting_other_amounts (D49): when a rule can be learned, the other amounts of the lines
still waiting from the same IBAN hash and sign (reconciled import, not a duplicate, no
confirmed row), each with its count, most frequent first, at most five; the panel then
asks whether those belong to the same category (same_amount_only).
unlearnable_categories: the categories the line's account takes for which a one-row
answer can never become a rule, with or without a typed pattern (phase 6 D160 on a
private account: the transfer, depot and tax-relevant codes and those without a
threshold; empty on the rental account), in taxonomy order, so the UI greys the box and
says why instead of letting rule.not_learnable refuse the answer.
rule: the rule this PUT created, if any.

TransferLegSource.title: TransferLegSource
TransferLegSource.description: Which table a transfer leg is a row of (phase 6 D162).

TransferLegView.title: TransferLegView
TransferLegView.description: One leg as the screens show it: its account by label, never an IBAN.

TransferLinkCreate.title: TransferLinkCreate
TransferLinkCreate.description: POST /transfers (a link by hand): exactly one out and one in leg.

TransferLinkKind.title: TransferLinkKind
TransferLinkKind.description: transfer_link.kind (migration 0025). Phase 7 adds chain, bridge and wrap.

TransferLinkView.title: TransferLinkView
TransferLinkView.description: GET /transfers?month=: a current link with both legs.

TransferUnlinkBody.title: TransferUnlinkBody
TransferUnlinkBody.description:
POST /transfers/{id}/unlink: the link that replaces the wrong one (append-only, D162:
the old row names the new one in superseded_by).

UnitRow.title: UnitRow
UnitRow.description:
One Z13 row per Wohnung (D71): the flat (wohnung = property) with its rooms listed, or an
MFH unit (wohnung = unit). pre_handover: the part booked before the handover (D63).
area_m2 None: an ETW or EFH with no Wohnfläche and no units, so no area is known; the
to-do income.living_area_missing asks for it (phase 2 D139).

UsefulLife.title: UsefulLife
UsefulLife.description:
§7 Abs. 4 S. 2 EStG (D79): the building's shorter actual useful life in whole years, as
the Gutachten (document_id on the row) states it; tax_year on the row is the first tax year
it applies to. The service refuses a life not shorter than the statutory one.

WageCertificate.title: WageCertificate
WageCertificate.description:
The confirmed figures of one Lohnsteuerbescheinigung (§5.1). A line the model did not
read is 0 with its field listed under `unread` (the review lets the user type it).

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

employee_name.description: the employee's name, to match the owner

church_tax.description: Nr. 6 Einbehaltene Kirchensteuer des Arbeitnehmers von 3.

church_tax_spouse.description: Nr. 7 Einbehaltene Kirchensteuer des Ehegatten von 3.

replacement_benefits.description: Nr. 15 Kurzarbeitergeld, Zuschuss zum Mutterschaftsgeld und ähnliche

employer_commute_tax_free.description: Nr. 17 Steuerfreie Arbeitgeberleistungen für Fahrten zwischen Wohnung und erster Tätigkeitsstätte

employer_commute_flat_taxed.description: Nr. 18 Pauschal besteuerte Arbeitgeberleistungen für Fahrten zwischen Wohnung und erster Tätigkeitsstätte

subsidy_health.description: Nr. 24a Steuerfreie Arbeitgeberzuschüsse zur gesetzlichen Krankenversicherung

subsidy_private_health.description: Nr. 24b Steuerfreie Arbeitgeberzuschüsse zur privaten Krankenversicherung

subsidy_care.description: Nr. 24c Steuerfreie Arbeitgeberzuschüsse zur gesetzlichen Pflegeversicherung

WageCertificateExtraction.title: WageCertificateExtraction
WageCertificateExtraction.description: Lohnsteuerbescheinigung: one employer's certificate for one year.

WaitingAmount.title: WaitingAmount
WaitingAmount.description: An amount other lines from the same IBAN and sign are waiting with, and how many.

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

valid_from.description: first month the plan applies to

iban.description: the WEG account the Hausgeld is paid to

WirtschaftsplanExtraction.title: WirtschaftsplanExtraction
WirtschaftsplanExtraction.description: Wirtschaftsplan: the monthly Hausgeld split the by_wirtschaftsplan rule reads (§8.1).

WorkRoomComponent.title: WorkRoomComponent
WorkRoomComponent.description: §5.4: the flat rate (a twelfth per month) against the room's share of the costs.

WorkRoomFact.title: WorkRoomFact
WorkRoomFact.description: The häusliches Arbeitszimmer (D106): Jahrespauschale or actual costs by the m² share.

Workspace.title: Workspace
